text:
[NDBG.14.19.1] Answers one call waiting in the Calls scope
([NDBG.13.1.1]), once.

Request: `{ "corr": "c-0012", "response": { "state": "on" } }`, or with
`error` in place of `response`.

`response` and `error` are as [NDBG.14.15.1] gives them. The answer lands as
an inject does ([NDBG.14.13.1]): into a live run at its end, and into a new
hypothesis fork anywhere else. A `corr` that names no waiting call → DAP
error.
